title: Desk Pain Trigger Map
dataSources: Posture readings (`posture:reading`), symptom logs (`symptom:log`), bathroom visits (`bathroom:visit`), sneeze events (`sneeze:event`).
app: Everyday body-signal logs — posture sensors, symptom and allergy journals, hydration-linked bathroom logs, and quirky personal counters — sent to Splunk HEC via wearables, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=symptom:log trigger=desk_work
| stats count as episodes, avg(severity) as avg_severity by body_area
| sort - episodes
description: Ranks the body areas most affected by desk-work-triggered pain or discomfort.
value: If pain repeats in the same places, it is often pointing at setup problems rather than random bad luck.
implementation: Tag symptom logs with trigger and body-area fields; summarize desk-related pain frequency and average severity.
visualization: Bar chart of desk-related pain episodes by body area.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces which parts of your body desk work keeps irritating, so the pattern points you toward an ergonomic fix.
